A school survey records whether students participate in sports and whether they play a musical instrument. The data is summarized in the table below.

|  | Plays Instrument | Doesn't Play Instrument |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Plays Sports | $24$ | $16$ |
| Doesn't Play Sports | $12$ | {{field-1}} |

Complete the frequency table given that, if a student who does not play sports is selected at random, the probability that the student plays a musical instrument is $\frac{3}{5}$.

A survey records whether people are teenagers, adults, or seniors and whether they prefer pizza, burgers, or pasta. The data is summarized in the table below.

|  | Pizza | Burgers | Pasta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Teenagers | $20$ | $15$ | $10$ |
| Adults | {{field-1}} | $12$ | $30$ |
| Seniors | $14$ | $16$ | $12$ |

Complete the frequency table given that, among adults, the probability that a randomly selected adult prefers pizza is $\frac{3}{10}$.

:topic/_knowledge-points.:topic/title: Finding Conditional Probabilities From Frequency Tables
